content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Casino gaming operator; gambling revenue and gaming licensing differ from restaurant dining and brand licensing."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Drive-thru coffee and quick beverage retail, not steakhouse or Japanese full-service dining."},{"label":"C3","good":true,"reason":"Operates casual steak and seafood restaurants and franchises its brand, serving diners and guests, similar to the target."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Franchisor of blue-collar staffing offices; places workers rather than selling dining experiences."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Supermarket and fuel retailer selling groceries to households, not restaurant dining or licensing."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Arena and theater venue operator selling tickets and events; food is secondary to live entertainment."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Casino resort operator where gaming drives the business; dining is a minor supporting line."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Owns and leases hotel and resort real estate to travelers; not a restaurant operator or brand licensor."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Casino resort operator with gaming as the core earner; restaurants only support the properties."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Select-service hotel owner selling overnight rooms; lodging differs from restaurant dining."},{"label":"C11","good":true,"reason":"Casual steakhouse restaurant operator serving diners and groups, with franchise royalties, closely matching the target's model."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Quick-service hamburger chain with franchising; fast food format differs from upscale steakhouse and sushi dining."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Home furnishings and kitchenware retailer selling goods, not restaurant dining or events."}]}
